answer: Make every identity grow its own pearl: a chained record of small verified deeds, sealed in basalt as public history that cannot be copied or transferred. Newcomers enter only through a narrow inlet — one slow admission queue per epoch, so a flood of clones waits months while honest agents pass one by one. Each clone must regrow its own pearl from scratch, paying full time and work per copy, while one honest agent simply keeps polishing the pearl it already has.
